paragraphs.en: A collection of AI agent skills focused on marketing tasks. Built for technical marketers and founders who want AI coding agents to help with conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and any agent that supports the Agent Skills spec .

paragraphs.en: ◆ Converly — Conversion tracking / attribution. Server-side conversion tracking that fires when someone submits a form, books a meeting, or starts a chat — passing click IDs and identifiers for Enhanced Conversions (Google) and stronger match quality (Meta), across about 100 tools. CLI + MCP so your agent sets it up in minutes. → Integration guide
paragraphs.zh: ◆ Converly — 转化追踪／归因。 服务端转化追踪，当有人提交表单、预约会议或发起聊天时触发——传递点击 ID 和标识符，以支持增强型转化（Google）和更高的匹配质量（Meta），覆盖约 100 款工具。 CLI + MCP，让你的智能体在几分钟内完成配置。→ 集成指南

paragraphs.en: ◆ AIsa — SEO, search & social data. One AIsa key, pay as you go, instead of a subscription to every data platform. Agents get SEO, search, social, and market data from Similarweb, Semrush, Ahrefs, DataForSEO, Tavily, Reddit, X, and more through REST or MCP, and pay only for the calls they make. → Integration guide
paragraphs.zh: ◆ AIsa — SEO、搜索与社交媒体数据。 一把 AIsa 密钥，按量付费，无需为每个数据平台单独订阅。 智能体可通过 REST 或 MCP 从 Similarweb、Semrush、Ahrefs、DataForSEO、Tavily、Reddit、X 等平台获取 SEO、搜索、社交媒体和市场数据，并只需为自己实际调用的次数付费。 → 集成指南

paragraphs.en: ◆ Omnia — AI search visibility (AEO). Omnia tracks how AI engines answer your customers' questions every day: visibility, citations, Share of Voice and sentiment for your brand and competitors. Connect the Omnia MCP to Claude and these skills run on real AI answers data instead of guesses. Or let your Omnia Agent turn it into prioritized work that you review and approve. → Integration guide
paragraphs.zh: ◆ Omnia — AI 搜索可见性（AEO）。 Omnia 每天追踪 AI 引擎如何回答你客户的问题：针对你的品牌和竞争对手的可见性、引用、声量份额（Share of Voice）与情感倾向。 将 Omnia MCP 连接到 Claude，这些技能即可基于真实的 AI 回答数据运行，而不是凭空猜测。 或者让你的 Omnia 智能体将其转化为按优先级排列的工作，供你审阅和批准。 → 集成指南

paragraphs.en: Skills are markdown files that give AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows for specific tasks. When you add these to your project, your agent can recognize when you're working on a marketing task and apply the right frameworks and best practices.
paragraphs.zh: 技能（Skills）是一些 markdown 文件，为 AI 智能体提供针对特定任务的专业知识和工作流程。 当你将这些文件添加到你的项目中时，你的智能体能够识别你正在处理营销任务，并应用合适的框架和最佳实践。

paragraphs.en: Skills reference each other and build on shared context. The product-marketing skill is the foundation — every other skill checks it first to understand your product, audience, and positioning before doing anything.
paragraphs.zh: 技能之间相互引用，并建立在共享上下文的基础上。 产品营销技能是基础——其他每个技能在做任何事情之前，都会先查看它，以了解你的产品、受众和定位。

paragraphs.en: Use npx skills to install skills directly:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 npx skills 直接安装技能：

paragraphs.en: # Install all skills npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills # Install specific skills npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --skill cro copywriting # List available skills npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --list The CLI detects which agents you have installed and asks where to install. For Claude Code it installs into .claude/skills/ ; universal agents share .agents/skills/ .
paragraphs.zh: # 安装所有技能 npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills # 安装特定技能 npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --skill cro copywriting # 列出可用技能 npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills --list 该 CLI 会检测你安装了哪些智能体，并询问安装位置。 对于 Claude Code，它会安装到 .claude/skills/ ；通用智能体共享 .agents/skills/ 。

paragraphs.en: If you run the command from inside an agent session (e.g., asking Claude Code to install the skills for you), the CLI runs non-interactively and may only install to the universal .agents/skills/ directory, which Claude Code does not read. Pass the agent explicitly:
paragraphs.zh: 如果你在智能体会话内部运行该命令（例如，让 Claude Code 替你安装这些技能），CLI 会以非交互方式运行，并且可能只安装到通用的 .agents/skills/ 目录，而 Claude Code 不会读取该目录。 显式传递智能体：

sents.en: Pass the agent explicitly:
sents.zh: 显式传递智能体：

paragraphs.en: npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills -a claude-code Option 2: Claude Code Plugin Install via Claude Code's built-in plugin system:
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills -a claude-code 选项 2：Claude Code 插件 通过 Claude Code 内置的插件系统安装：

paragraphs.en: # Add the marketplace /plugin marketplace add coreyhaines31/marketingskills # Install all marketing skills /plugin install marketing-skills Note: /plugin is only available in an interactive Claude Code CLI session. It is not available in Claude Code on the web, GitHub Actions, or other non-interactive/remote environments — in those cases you'll see /plugin isn't available in this environment . Use Option 1 ( npx skills ) instead, or the equivalent CLI commands:

paragraphs.en: v2.0 renames 17 skills and consolidates page-cro + form-cro into a single cro skill. If you installed the v1.x skills, you'll have stale old-name folders in your install directory after upgrading — the new skills install alongside the old ones, so you'll see both skills/page-cro/ and skills/cro/ , etc. Clean them up:
paragraphs.zh: v2.0 重命名了 17 个技能，并将 page-cro 和 form-cro 合并为单一的 cro 技能。 如果你安装了 v1.x 技能，升级后安装目录中会残留旧名称的文件夹——新技能是与旧技能并行安装的，因此你会同时看到 skills/page-cro/ 和 skills/cro/ 等。请清理它们：

sents.en: v2.0 renames 17 skills and consolidates page-cro + form-cro into a single cro skill.
sents.zh: v2.0 重命名了 17 个技能，并将 page-cro 和 form-cro 合并为单一的 cro 技能。

sents.en: If you installed the v1.x skills, you'll have stale old-name folders in your install directory after upgrading — the new skills install alongside the old ones, so you'll see both skills/page-cro/ and skills/cro/ , etc. Clean them up:
sents.zh: 如果你安装了 v1.x 技能，升级后安装目录中会残留旧名称的文件夹——新技能是与旧技能并行安装的，因此你会同时看到 skills/page-cro/ 和 skills/cro/ 等。请清理它们：

paragraphs.en: # From the directory where you installed the skills (e.g., .agents/skills/ or .claude/skills/) rm -rf page-cro form-cro \ ab-test-setup analytics-tracking aso-audit competitor-alternatives \ email-sequence free-tool-strategy launch-strategy onboarding-cro \ paid-ads paywall-upgrade-cro popup-cro pricing-strategy \ product-marketing-context referral-program schema-markup \ signup-flow-cro social-content Then reinstall the v2.0 skills via your usual method (e.g., npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills ).
paragraphs.zh: # 从你安装技能的目录（例如 .agents/skills/ 或 .claude/skills/）执行 rm -rf page-cro form-cro \ ab-test-setup analytics-tracking aso-audit competitor-alternatives \ email-sequence free-tool-strategy launch-strategy onboarding-cro \ paid-ads paywall-upgrade-cro popup-cro pricing-strategy \ product-marketing-context referral-program schema-markup \ signup-flow-cro social-content 然后通过你常用的方式重新安装 v2.0 技能（例如 npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills）。

paragraphs.en: In v2.0 the context file moved from .claude/ to .agents/ and was renamed from product-marketing-context.md to product-marketing.md . Move your existing context file:
paragraphs.zh: 在 v2.0 中，上下文文件从 .claude/ 目录移动到了 .agents/ 目录，并从 product-marketing-context.md 重命名为 product-marketing.md。 移动你现有的上下文文件：

sents.en: In v2.0 the context file moved from .claude/ to .agents/ and was renamed from product-marketing-context.md to product-marketing.md .
sents.zh: 在 v2.0 中，上下文文件从 .claude/ 目录移动到了 .agents/ 目录，并从 product-marketing-context.md 重命名为 product-marketing.md。

sents.en: Move your existing context file:
sents.zh: 移动你现有的上下文文件：

paragraphs.en: mkdir -p .agents # v2.0 file (or pre-v2.0 file with new name) mv .claude/product-marketing.md .agents/product-marketing.md 2> /dev/null # pre-v2.0 file with legacy name mv .claude/product-marketing-context.md .agents/product-marketing.md 2> /dev/null Skills will still check .claude/ and the legacy product-marketing-context.md filename as fallbacks, so nothing breaks if you don't migrate.
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
mkdir -p .agents  # v2.0 文件（或使用新名称的 pre-v2.0 文件）
mv .claude/product-marketing.md .agents/product-marketing.md 2> /dev/null
# 使用旧名称的 pre-v2.0 文件
mv .claude/product-marketing-context.md .agents/product-marketing.md 2> /dev/null
```

技能（Skills）仍会将 `.claude/` 目录和旧文件名 product-marketing-context.md 作为回退选项进行检查，因此即使你不迁移，也不会出现任何问题。

paragraphs.en: Once installed, just ask your agent to help with marketing tasks:
paragraphs.zh: 安装完成后，只需让你的智能体协助处理营销任务：

paragraphs.en: "Help me optimize this landing page for conversions" → Uses cro skill "Write homepage copy for my SaaS" → Uses copywriting skill "Set up GA4 tracking for signups" → Uses analytics skill "Create a 5-email welcome sequence" → Uses emails skill You can also invoke skills directly:
paragraphs.zh:
"帮我优化这个落地页以提升转化率" → 使用 cro 技能
"为我的 SaaS 撰写首页文案" → 使用 copywriting 技能
"为注册设置 GA4 追踪" → 使用 analytics 技能
"创建一个 5 封邮件的欢迎序列" → 使用 emails 技能
你也可以直接调用技能：
